board.name: Arduino Uno R3
board.notes: Arduino Uno R3 is the primary robot controller. Pins 0 and 1 are reserved for USB serial communication. Use only 5V-compatible signals on digital inputs.

constraints.reserved_reason: Pins 0 and 1 are used for hardware UART and USB serial communication.
constraints.pwm_note: Only pins 3, 5, 6, 9, 10 and 11 support PWM output.
constraints.serial_note: Avoid assigning robot hardware signals to pins 0 and 1 because they are used for USB serial communication.

parts.purpose: Primary microcontroller for motor control, ultrasonic sensing, servo control and communication with the Python navigation system.
Optional secondary development controller. Not required for the initial robot prototype.
Optional Wi-Fi communication module for future wireless monitoring and control.
parts.electrical_note: Uses 3.3V logic. Do not connect 5V signals directly to ESP8266 GPIO pins.

parts.purpose: Controls the speed and direction of the two DC gear motors.
parts.electrical_note: Motor power must come from a suitable external motor supply. Connect controller and driver grounds together.

parts.purpose: Measures the distance to obstacles in front of the robot.
parts.electrical_note: Operates with 5V supply and 5V-compatible signal levels. ECHO is compatible with Arduino Uno digital inputs.

parts.purpose: Rotates the ultrasonic sensor to scan left, front and right directions.
parts.electrical_note: Requires a suitable separate regulated 5V to 6V supply with adequate current capacity. Do not power directly from an Arduino GPIO or rely on the Uno 5V pin.

parts.part: Two-wheel robot chassis with DC gear motors
parts.purpose: Physical mobile robot platform for autonomous navigation and path planning.
Prototyping and connecting the sensor and controller circuits.
Optional wireless serial communication for robot commands and telemetry.
parts.electrical_note: Confirm the exact module model and voltage requirements before connecting it.

navigation.localization_note: Wheel encoders and an IMU are not currently confirmed. Position estimates based on movement duration may drift.

power.motor_supply: External supply matched to DC motor ratings
power.servo_supply: Separate regulated 5V to 6V supply with adequate current capacity
power.safety_note: Do not assume a battery voltage or connect the motor and servo supplies until their ratings and wiring have been verified.
